snippet.title: Nested - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Nested is a cute, 3D grid-based puzzle game built around the concept of russian nesting dolls. Come twist your brain as you stack, push and interact with the various objects you'll find in each levels. Let's see if you can reach the right combination of nesting dolls to solve every one of them!

Wishlist it on Steam! It helps me out a lot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3752780/Nested/
